outcome: extreme neonatal hyperbilirubinaemia (plasma bilirubin level >= 450 mmol/L)
cohort: Cases were neonates >= 36 weeks gestation with extreme hyperbilirubinaemia in South Australia between January 2010 and December 2021, with population data from the SA Health Pregnancy Outcome Unit serving as controls.
finding: The incidence of extreme hyperbilirubinaemia in South Australia was 28.6/100 000 births over 12 years, remaining mostly stable but higher than previously reported, and was associated with Asian ethnicity, ventouse delivery, and early discharge, with a peak in 2020 temporally linked to the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic.
mod_finding: Ventouse delivery was identified as an association with extreme hyperbilirubinaemia.
